error_message: Google Drive rejected the exact image-generation runtime file reference as unavailable for connector egress.
public_page_impact: No website file changed; no portrait was uploaded or published.
recovery_action: Validated the generated source as native PNG/RGBA 1141x1379 with alpha extrema 0-255 and exact SHA256, then attempted the destination schema's exact runtime file reference once. Because the connector still returned explicit BLOCKED_FILE_REFERENCE, the denied Drive-preservation operation was stopped without copying, renaming, rehosting, URL rewriting, endpoint switching, resizing or regeneration.
notes: This is the second consecutive new generated portrait in this run to receive the same explicit connector-egress denial. Treat Drive preservation/publication capability as unavailable for new generated images for the remainder of this run; do not generate a third unusable master. Keep the rollout enabled for later recovery-only checks.
